title: AI Girlfriend becomes a Unit
notes: Meditative #49.3 AI Girlfriend becomes a plain Unit and drops Animated from both faces; YileGPT Prime's Cry summons it straight into a unit zone (R64), fizzling with every unit zone full. Stats, cost, Can't attack, the start-of-turn forced attacks (R53) and the after-attacked Nerf (R1026, MD-C26) are unchanged.
